_readme: Site glossary for en/ (v2). shared = WoowTech series names and chrome terms reused across the 13 sites (kept verbatim from the kit seed; the Headscale/Tailscale rows below are seed leftovers and are simply unused here). terms = EMQX / MQTT / Home Assistant add-on domain terms for THIS site — upstream EMQX wording wins. keepEnglish = never translate or rephrase. forbid = words the reviewer rejects. decisions = the binding cross-chapter wording agreed before the 22 chapters are translated in parallel: section headings, data-nav labels, chapter nav labels, pager chrome, callout openers, table headers, Chinese strings inside frozen code blocks, and the Taiwan-specific examples that policy=localize replaces. The plain-text version of the same table is /home/user/out/terms_emqx.txt — that is what translators and reviewers read.
principles: Upstream English UI/docs wording wins (headscale.net, tailscale.com/kb).
Product names, CLI commands, config keys, file names, hostnames and placeholders stay verbatim; Chinese placeholders become <your-…> style.
US spelling; sentence case for headings, nav and buttons; Title Case for product and WoowTech series names.
Second person 'you'; direct, like a senior engineer onboarding a beginner; no 'In this chapter we will', no marketing adjectives, no emoji.
Callout labels are fixed: Concept: / Tip: / Warning: / Danger:; full-width punctuation becomes ASCII; 第 N 章 → Chapter N; 圖 N-M → Figure N-M.

For THIS site the upstream that wins is docs.emqx.com/en/emqx/v5.8 plus the Woow_ha_emqx add-on README / config.yaml / CHANGELOG; the headscale.net / tailscale.com pointer in the first principle is a leftover from the kit seed and does not apply to EMQX.

The 名詞對照 table is an English->Chinese gloss table in zh. In en/ it stays a three-column table with the same row count: Term / Plain English / In one line. The second column becomes a plain-English gloss of the term (MQTT Broker -> message broker), never the word 'Chinese' and never a transliteration.

decisions._readme: Binding cross-chapter wording. localize.客廳 → living-room: Every MQTT topic segment 客廳 becomes living-room, and the prose 'the living room' stays a living room. This keeps ch1/ch4/ch7 examples readable without inventing a new scenario. Code blocks are frozen — file the topic strings as a proposal in i18n/_proposals/, do not edit <pre>/<code> in place.
localize.溫度／濕度／東／西／上／開關 → temperature / humidity: The Chinese topic segments under 客廳 become their English equivalents so the +/# wildcard walkthrough in ch4 still demonstrates one level vs many.
localize.群組名／群組／主題 → <group> / <topic>: Shared-subscription placeholders become angle-bracket English placeholders ($share/<group>/<topic>).
localize.玄關的燈 → the hallway light: ch19's 'turn off the entryway light from outside' becomes the hallway light — an entryway/玄關 is a Taiwanese apartment fixture that does not read the same abroad.
localize.台灣繁體中文 → US English: skills.html's editorial rules tell the agent to write in Taiwan Traditional Chinese. In en/ the same rule must say US English, and the rule '首次技術詞採中文（English）' becomes 'define each technical term on first use'. Add a Note: only if the surrounding sentence would otherwise read as if two languages were in play.
localize.繁體中文 22 章教學 → 22-chapter tutorial: index.html and tutorial.html meta descriptions advertise the tutorial as Traditional Chinese. Drop the language claim rather than replacing it with 'English'.
localize.&lt;Home Assistant 位址&gt; → <home-assist: Host placeholders become <host> / <home-assistant-host>. Real host names in the source (homeassistant, localhost, 127.0.0.1, something@else.local) are already generic — leave them exactly as they are.
localize.[28 度] → [28 C]: prompts.html's temperature threshold keeps the number and drops the Chinese degree word; do not convert to Fahrenheit — that would change a fact.
localize.Asia/Taipei / LINE / 台電 / TWD: None present. Nothing to substitute — do not invent one.

zh_source_issues: Connector is glossed three ways in ch11: the 名詞對照 table says 連線器, the prose says Connector（連線） and Connector（連線器）, and the troubleshoot list says 連接器. One English word: connector.
Sink is 輸出端 in the ch11/ch12 tables but Sink（輸出） in ch11 prose.
授權 means two different things: License in ch3 (授權 banner, the License page) and Authorization in ch7. Reading it as 'authorization' in ch3 would be a factual error.
驗證 means two different things: Authentication in ch6/ch7/ch22 and 'verify' in ch5 (驗證 QoS) and ch20 (驗證還原).
憑證 means Credential in the ch6 table and Certificate in the ch8 table.
內建資料庫 glosses Built-in Database in ch6 (the authenticator backend) and Mnesia in ch20 (the storage engine).
The troubleshoot section's data-nav is 排錯 in ch1-4 and ch9-22 but 故障排除 in ch5-8, while its h2 is 故障排除 everywhere. Same for the why section: data-nav 為什麼 in ch1-4/ch9-22 vs 為什麼要學這個 in ch5-8.

The 名詞對照 section carries four different ids across chapters: what (ch1-8, ch19-22), power (ch9), actions (ch10), words (ch11-18). Structure parity means en/ must keep each chapter's own id — do not normalize them.
Its third column header is also inconsistent: 一句話 in 15 chapters, 說明 in the other 7.
Payload is 訊息內容 in ch5 and 內容體 in ch16. QoS is 服務品質 in ch4/ch14 and 服務品質等級 in ch5. Log is 記錄檔 in the ch18/ch22 tables but 日誌 in 日誌等級 / 日誌追蹤. API key is API 金鑰 in ch18 and 介面金鑰 in ch21.
Ports: ch2's h2 says 連接埠 but its data-nav says 埠, and ch8's h2 says 埠. Use 'port' throughout.
ch11 calls the free edition 開源版（Community） once; the other 52 mentions across the site say Open Source. EMQX's own name for it is Open Source.

index.html advertises 超過 45 條提示詞 while prompts.html's h1 says 50 條 and the page really contains 50 prompt cards. policy.json requires prompts.html to state the true count, so the two pages must agree in en/.
WebSocket is glossed 網頁套件通道 in the ch5 and ch8 tables, which is not what WebSocket means. Keep the English term and write a correct one-line gloss; do not back-translate the zh gloss.
ch1's step 2 reads 若還沒進不去 (a double negative that contradicts itself). Translate the intent — 'if you cannot get in yet' — and report it on the zh side rather than smoothing it silently.
Prometheus is glossed 普羅米修斯 in the ch15 table (a transliteration). Keep Prometheus.
